messages:
oncall-bot: Pager duty triggered -> HIGH: elevated 5xx and timeouts hitting hosted API (global). Auto-create incident thread at 2026-03-15T20:17Z :rotating_light:
elena_sre: Acked. Jumping in. Observing 5xx spike starting ~20:12Z, error ratio ~14% over baseline for /v1/* routes. Traces point to control-plane org-lookup path failing with 502/504 from org-lookup-service.
raj_dev: I can reproduce in staging with a traffic replay. Stack shows org-lookup fanout to auth and billing timed out -> cascade. Logs: `org-lookup: downstream timeout (ctx=500ms) -> 504`.
maria_ops: Rolling view: NA regions worst, some EU p95 latency up too. Are we seeing any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy: config-service v2.14.7 -> v2.14.8 rolled 19:58Z (no risk flags) — started CI smoke checks passed.
elena_sre: Not seeing config-service errors in traces, it's org-lookup specifically. Could be a heartbeating or DB connection saturation. I'm attaching quick query: `sum(rate(org_lookup_errors[1m])) by (error)` shows a big spike in `downstream_502`.
tess_product: PS — Support is getting inbound chats. Need a quick customer impact note.
support-liz: Confirmed multiple customers report 502s from Redwood API. Severity: high for interactive products. Logging: ticket queue has 7 priority-1s so far. Sending templated notice once we have mitigation.
elena_sre: Triage plan: 1) activate cache-fallback for org-lookup to reduce fanout 2) increase org-lookup replicas/CPU to relieve saturation 3) apply short circuit / fallback routing in gateway for failures 4) create incident ticket and update comms.
raj_dev: On it. First step locally to enable cached path: toggling env `ENABLE_CACHE_FALLBACK=true` on org-lookup. Running patch then scale.
elena_sre: Commands I'm running now — paste for audit:
```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/org-lookup ENABLE_CACHE_FALLBACK=true --overwrite
kubectl -n controlplane scale deploy/org-lookup --replicas=8
```
elena_sre: Patch applied. Scaled to 8. Waiting for pods ready.
maria_ops: I can see pod restart churn modest, but new pods ready ~20:22Z.
raj_dev: Enabling fallback cut error ratio down to ~7% within 60s. Good signal. Continuing.
incident-bot: Incident created -> INC-2026-0315-023 (controlplane org-lookup dependency). Severity: P1.
elena_sre: Next, add a temporary gateway rule to shorten fanout and fail fast after 150ms to avoid cascading timeouts.
raj_dev: Pushing gateway rule now (dry-run -> apply).
```
# gateway rule snippet
routes:
  - match: "/v1/*"
    controls:
      org_lookup: {timeout_ms:150, fallback_to_cache:true}
```

raj_dev: Rule applied to canary gateway nodes. Monitoring.

elena_sre: After gateway rule, p50 latency improved, 5xx rate down to ~3.5%. Still seeing intermittent 502s from billing lookup when enriched requests happen.
tess_product: Do we know which customers were hit hardest? Support list shows two large accounts with elevated errors — flagged them as possible SLA impact.
support-liz: Sent interim note to affected customers with context + ETA for mitigation. Added link to incident page.
elena_sre: Root cause hypothesis: org-lookup fanout increases connection counts to billing + auth; a sudden config change in billing client (connection pool shrink) and a burst of index lookups caused transient downstream 502s. We'll validate with billing team.
maria_ops: I triggered a temporary bypass: `GATEWAY_DISABLE_ORG_ENRICH=true` for the gateway role handling public API to reduce fanout. Applying now.
raj_dev: Command: `kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway GATEWAY_DISABLE_ORG_ENRICH=true` -> applied.
maria_ops: After bypass, error rate stabilized to ~1.2% across clusters. That's within acceptable SLO degradation window.
elena_sre: Good. Next actions: - run postmortem capture (please save logs, traces, config diffs) - coordinate a rollback/patch for billing client connection pool - schedule a controlled rollout for org-lookup change once validated - update customers with root-cause and mitigation timeline.
raj_dev: Placing a quick config patch for billing client to increase pool and backoff: `billing.client.maxConns=80 -> 200` and increase timeout. Will test in canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy billing-client-config v3.2.1 -> monitoring canary at 20:38Z.

elena_sre: Monitoring canary. If green for 10m, we promote.
support-liz: Support will update the customer note: current mitigation: cache fallback + gateway bypass + increased replicas. ETA for full remediation: 3 hours to validate and roll billing fix to all.
tess_product: I'll post a short internal status in #general once we have full remediation confirmed.

elena_sre: Quick impact numbers as of 20:35Z — estimated customer-facing error rate averaged 2% over last 10m, ~18k failed requests, majority (70%) were auth/org-enrichment paths; top affected region: us-west. No data exfiltration or auth bypass observed.

maria_ops: Pager handoff: I'll keep coverage for next 2 hours while elena takes lead on postmortem. Oncall rotation note posted.

elena_sre: Acknowledged. I will start the incident doc: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0315-023 — add any logs/traces there.

raj_dev: After canary validation (20:46Z) promoting billing config to prod.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 20:51Z.

elena_sre: Final checks show 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.2% at 20:55Z. Marking incident moving to 'post-incident review' state.

support-liz: Sent final customer update: mitigation in place, no ongoing errors, investigating root cause and next steps.

tess_product: Thanks team. Please capture follow-ups: (1) increase org-lookup cache hit targets, (2) add automated circuit breaker earlier in call path, (3) run load test for org-enrichment fanout.

elena_sre: Agreed. Will file RFCs and assign owners in the postmortem. Wrapping thread. :white_check_mark:
